An '''individual''' with the rank of [[Captain/Legends|captain]] worked for the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. The fleet under this captain's command attacked a fuel tanker, the [[Aurora (fuel tanker)/Legends|''Aurora'']] to make them ask for the ''[[Starcrusher/Legends|Starcrusher]]''{{'s}} help. When the huge ship arrived, the captain's fleet left the [[Star system/Legends|system]].
